root_cause.embedded_identity: Environment::embedded stores embedded_info and has remote_client=None. is_remote() checks remote_client.is_some(); uses_exec_backend() is is_remote() || is_embedded().
root_cause.effect: Embedded was classified as Platform during patch authorization, despite its backend-managed execution. get_platform_sandbox returns None on iOS. A writable managed-profile patch therefore lacks sandbox_available in assess_patch_safety and is rejected under AskForApproval::Never (or asks under eligible approval policies).
root_cause.qualified_limit: This is source proof of the routing defect, not a reproduced phone result or a guarantee that every other operation succeeds.

routing_inventory.actual: get_filesystem() clones the selected registered filesystem, then codex_apply_patch::apply_patch_with_options receives fs and file_system_sandbox_context_for_attempt. No extra is_remote gate or host-native process spawn here.
routing_inventory.effect: Uses the registered ScopedExecutorFileSystem for Embedded. It does not need to invoke the shell ExecBackend to perform filesystem operations.

routing_inventory.actual: Backend-managed execution avoids platform sandbox selection while retaining sandbox_requested and effective permission context. SandboxType::None here is not a request to disable backend enforcement.

routing_inventory.entry: Apply-patch library and scoped mutation preflight
routing_inventory.actual: Official parsed hunks enumerate every write/delete and both move endpoints before mutation, and ScopedExecutorFileSystem intersects host authority with passed context. No remote-only selector in this I/O path.

preserved_safety: No approval policy changes. patch_approval_requirement still calls assess_patch_safety; AutoApprove still becomes Skip with bypass_sandbox=false.
Every add/delete/update source and move destination remains checked by is_write_patch_constrained_to_writable_paths. Empty patches, RO targets and denied paths retain rejection behavior.
Existing granted-permission calculation, additional-permission derivation, orchestrator approval/escalation rules and explicit filesystem context remain unchanged.

ExecutorManaged uses configured virtual-path policy matching rather than host-native path canonicalization. This aligns matching with the embedded filesystem namespace; it does not create new permissions.

Registered ScopedFiles authority, context restrictions and full-batch mutation preflight remain active. No filesystem, readonly policy, preflight, source/destination enumeration or native fallback changes are proposed.
Native local environments still return false from uses_exec_backend and retain Platform handling; remote environments still return true and retain ExecutorManaged handling.
The trusted Environment::embedded constructor contract still requires supplied providers to enforce every request or reject before I/O. Backend routing alone is not proof of a security boundary.
